title: Constitutional Capitalism Systems Intelligence Engine
subtitle: Whole-system impact engine — RedDirt-connected intelligence, simulation, and learning; AI analyzes, humans decide

build_order: Philosophy, doctrine, evidence, legal analysis, modeling, manuscript, education, publication packages
Phase 8 — registered anonymous line-level scholarly collaboration
Phase 9 — AI intelligence, simulation, digital twin, whole-system impact analysis

final_product_statement.text: A transparent, evidence-grounded operating system for exploring how constitutional structure, markets, public investment, ownership, and civic participation can produce broader prosperity—while allowing citizens, scholars, and leaders to test assumptions before acting on them.

core_capability.text: Change one input, then show the direct effects, indirect effects, delayed effects, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and possible unintended consequences across the entire system.

is_not: A chatbot bolted onto the website
Autonomous author of doctrine or manuscript
Inventor of citations or silent assumption changes
is: Structured intelligence layer connected to the project database and RedDirt civic-data spine
Whole-system impact engine over a knowledge graph
Instrument for understanding, challenging, simulating, and improving — under human authority

reddirt_connection.rule: SIE consumes validated, secret-free, multi-source public statistics and project registries — never campaign identity, private records, or broad RedDirt credentials from Astro/GitHub.

authority_chain.text: Contributor proposes → AI analyzes → reviewers examine → simulations are tested → authorized humans decide → decision ledger records the result.
authority_chain.collaborative_chain: AI analyzes → humans review → authorized humans decide → decision ledger records the outcome.
ai_never: automatically modify doctrine or manuscript text

capabilities.title: AI Research Analyst
capabilities.summary: Examine any claim for support, challenge, source strength, outdated sources, unstated assumptions, open proof gates, contradictions, and doctrine-ahead-of-evidence gaps. Distinguish verified facts, supported interpretations, project assumptions, illustrative parameters, unresolved hypotheses, and speculative ideas.

capabilities.title: Simulation Engine
capabilities.summary: Slider-driven scenario estimates (e.g., Community Prosperity Accounts: local share, returns, growth, exposure caps, participation, failure rates, portability). Outputs labeled scenario estimates, not predictions. Horizons may include 10/20/40 years.

capabilities.title: Policy Tradeoff Laboratory
capabilities.summary: Test benefit/cost/unintended-consequence questions across food procurement, regenerative payments, local ownership incentives, emergency reserves, EMS volunteer decline, local retirement exposure, and distributional winners/losers — surface tradeoffs rather than advocate blindly.

capabilities.title: Learning Mode
capabilities.summary: Every simulation teaches: diversification, liquidity, municipal finance, fiduciary duty, multipliers, risk-adjusted returns — education through interactive consequence.

capabilities.title: Community Digital Twin
capabilities.summary: Simplified models of city/county/region/state (population, income, tax base, housing, energy, food, EMS, schools, healthcare, debt, civic participation) comparing Constitutional Capitalism mechanisms to baseline.

capabilities.title: AI-Assisted Collaborative Review
capabilities.summary: Group comments, summarize agreement/disagreement, extract proposed claims, flag unsupported assertions, detect sources, compare rewrites — never auto-edit doctrine.

capabilities.title: Red Team Mode
capabilities.summary: Generate strongest good-faith objections from multiple perspectives (constitutional conservative, civil libertarian, progressive economist, market liberal, municipal finance, rural leader, labor, small business, taxpayer, administrator).

capabilities.title: Constitutional and Legal Analysis Assist
capabilities.summary: Map proposals to constitutional provisions, federalism, due process, equal protection, property, tax/spend authority, securities, pension fiduciary, municipal debt, state limits, administrative law — labeled research assistance, not legal advice or final judgment.

capabilities.title: Personalized Learning Paths
capabilities.summary: Same doctrine; adaptive examples/depth for Citizen, Student, Farmer, Business owner, Mayor, Legislator, Economist, Attorney, Researcher, Community organizer.

capabilities.title: Evidence-Grounded Answers
capabilities.summary: Prefer project database over general memory when relevant. Show claims, sources, confidence, assumptions, disputes, affected principles, last review date. Refuse to present illustrative parameters as established facts.

capabilities.title: AI Governance Controls
capabilities.summary: No autonomous doctrine/publication/assumption changes; no invented citations; no hidden uncertainty; complete prompt/decision logging for consequential outputs; human approval for all canonical changes.

capabilities.title: Whole-System Impact Engine
capabilities.summary: Trace direct, second-order, third-order, and long-term effects; reinforcing and balancing loops; time delays; correlation vs causation labels; suggestion System Impact Reviews; conflict detection; distributional and geographic analysis; scenario comparison; sensitivity analysis; multi-dimension system health dashboard without a single score hiding tradeoffs.

knowledge_graph.title: Constitutional Capitalism Knowledge Graph
knowledge_graph.rule: Never present all connections with equal confidence.

example.name: Local retirement investment share
example.note: Illustrative until modeled; exposure caps and diversified majority holdings required.

suggestion_impact_review.title: System Impact Review
sections: Recommendation for consideration (test ranges — not accept/reject)

system_health_dashboard.rule: No single score should hide tradeoffs. Show the full profile.

all_required: Phase 2 / 2.1 proof maturity for priority domains
Legal review and economic modeling no longer uniformly 0% for simulated claims
Manuscript and Public Education Edition mature enough to ground learning modes
Phase 8 Collaborative Review platform protected and operational (or staged dual-build with strict isolation)
Knowledge graph and variable contracts populated for simulated domains
RedDirt → CC validated snapshot path proven for baseline measures used in twins
AI governance logging, refusal rules, and human-approval gates implemented
Simulations visibly labeled scenario estimates — never forecasts

implementation_status.phase_2_action: Capture architecture only. Do not build chatbot, sliders, or twin backends in Phase 2.
implementation_status.modeling_honesty: Modeling remains 0% until real models exist — this framework does not inflate modeling progress.
